# Index

## pattern

- [An OAuth MCP server's verify passes on a static token while interactive clients cannot register](patterns/dcr-disabled-silently.md) — An OAuth MCP server's gate stayed green while interactive MCP connectors could no longer connect · Auth hardening disabled Dynamic Client Registration · Re-enable DCR
- [A keepalive response served from Cloudflare's cache](patterns/keepalive-probe-cached.md) — Keepalive sweeps succeeded with no corresponding activity at the target · The Worker's `fetch` to the target could be answered by Cloudflare's cache, so the request never left the edge · Make keepalive subrequests uncacheable
- [A Supabase keepalive that never reaches Postgres](patterns/keepalive-probe-misses-postgres.md) — The keepalive Worker reported a Supabase-backed tool healthy on every sweep, but the project paused anyway after a week · Three faults in a row kept the probe from reaching Postgres: a schema-cache path, an edge-cached subrequest, then a subrequest that threw before it was sent · Probe a dedicated table with `cache: 'no-store'` only (0.9.0 → 0.10.1); unverified until a deployed sweep reaches the table
- [Idle-time polling keeps a scale-to-zero Neon compute awake](patterns/neon-never-sleeps.md) — An idle containerized app with a Neon database queried Postgres about 50,000 times a day · Three timers ran without doing useful work: a job-queue poll every 2 seconds, a stale-job reaper every 60 seconds, and a container healthcheck every 30 seconds against `/health`, which queries the database · Wake workers on enqueue instead of polling, and schedule one wake-up for work that is due later
- [A liveness probe that touches a layer it is not managing](patterns/probe-touches-wrong-layer.md) — A container tool's keepalive probed `/health`, which checks the database · The probe exists to detect a reclaimed or dead container · Split liveness from readiness
- [The verify settle loop can pass against the previous deployment](patterns/settle-greenlights-previous-deploy.md) — Verify passed right after a deploy whose new artifact was broken · The settle loop retries checks until they pass, to absorb eventual consistency · Since 0.8, the tool serves its build sha at `/__version`
- [A typo or unknown field in a verify spec silently disables an assertion](patterns/spec-typo-disables-assertion.md) — A check written to assert something passed even when that something was broken · The harness ignored fields it did not recognize, so a misspelling (or a field from a newer version) turned an assertion into a no-op while the gate read green · Strict specs: an unknown, wrong-typed or uncompilable field fails as `spec is valid — checks[i]: unsupported field "…"`
- [A Terraform apply that replaces running compute without anyone planning it](patterns/unplanned-compute-replacement.md) — An env change on a container tool planned a delete-then-create of its instance, and apply-on-push executed it · Some attribute changes force replacement, and the free tier releases the old cores minutes late · Since 0.10.1 `infra.yml` fails a plan that replaces a running container instance unless dispatched with `allow_compute_replace=true`

## fact

- [Gemini API free tier (the bench's model provider)](facts/gemini-free.md) — Google publishes no per-model free-tier table, so these values were measured on 2026-11-12 with one-token `generateContent` probes against the project the bench's key belongs to

## decision

- [Building agents never receive incident pages or unconfirmed patterns](decisions/incidents-hidden.md) — Skills give building agents intent, liveness, decisions, facts and contract pages
- [Neon is the default Postgres; Supabase only for bundled auth, storage and realtime](decisions/neon-default-over-supabase.md) — Neon gives branch-per-env Postgres that scales to zero and resumes automatically, so it needs no keepalive
- [Skill changes roll back; the wiki does not](decisions/wiki-never-rolls-back.md) — This follows the paper: a rejected proposal reverts the skill, never the wiki

## incident

- [The keepalive was green, and a Supabase-backed app's database paused anyway](incidents/2026-08-keepalive-green-database-paused.md) — Three different causes produced one symptom: a probe that stopped at a cache, a caret range that kept the deployed Worker on the old release, and a cache fix that made the Worker throw
- [An idle container app kept its Neon compute awake](incidents/2026-09-idle-app-neon-never-sleeps.md) — Suspension needs five quiet minutes, and the app never gave it one
